name: memento
description: Multi-layer cache memory base. L3 (sources) -> L2 (wiki) -> L1 (AGENTS.md) compilation pipeline with a hardened deterministic eval gate (source evidence proves provenance; compiled answer surfaces must contain required atoms; ungated runs are explicit), health checks, passive session capture (save, with structured trajectory telemetry), active LLM-driven interview (ama), lightweight follow-up queue review (followups), and gated promotion of local skills/tools to a marketplace git repo, defaulting to the active Memento/RSI target (promote — sole writer of the promotion ledger, composes actuary --tier as Gate-1 through harness-native skill invocation or direct workflow fallback). Knowledge base only — commitments belong in the user's issue tracker.

interface.longDescription: Multi-layer local memory base. Seven skills cover the full loop: memento-config (setup + ongoing config), health-check (read-only doctor + the eval gate's golden-query scorer + promotion-ledger integrity), save (passive session capture + structured trajectory channel), ama (active LLM-driven interview), compile (sources -> wiki -> AGENTS.md hot set, gated by a deterministic eval + auto-rollback that protects the compiled answer surface before commit; ungated runs are explicit), followups (lightweight follow-up queue review — expired-first), and promote (gated promotion of local skills/tools to a marketplace git repo, defaulting to the active Memento/RSI target; sole writer of the promotion ledger; composes actuary --tier as Gate-1 through harness-native skill invocation or direct workflow fallback). Knowledge base only; real commitments belong in the user's issue tracker. Supports a configurable Memento data root for global plugin installs.
defaultPrompt: Set up a memory base in this repo.
Run a health check on my memory base.
Compile my sources into the wiki.
Save this session and capture useful context.
Ask me anything to fill in gaps in my wiki.
